description.content:
Ads are the brand advertisements used to drive actions for a brand and earn payouts. Ads can be purely text (such as just a link), or can consist of some type of creative (e.g. a banner image, video, or audio) with an embedded impact.com tracking link. All ads have a tracking link unique to your partner account that will credit you with an action if a payable event occurs (such as a customer converting).
